image_description: A close-up photograph of a green, unripe fig fruit attached to a woody branch. The fig is pear-shaped with a smooth, matte green skin and a visible ostiole at the bottom. It is surrounded by large, lobed green fig leaves with prominent yellow-green veins and stems. The background consists of blurred foliage.

Texture is internal/tactile and the fruit appears unripe (firm/green), making this checkpoint untestable and likely not present in this specific state.
